name: Reqres
description: A fake user API with realistic responses, including pagination, errors and a pretend login. Writes are faked, so nothing is saved.
auth: None (the login request returns a fake token)

requests.name: List users
requests.description: Returns one page of users, with paging info (page, per_page, total).

requests.name: User not found
requests.description: A user that doesn't exist, so you can see a 404.

requests.name: Create a user
requests.description: Pretends to create a user. Responds with 201, an id and createdAt.

requests.name: Log in
requests.description: Returns a fake token for this demo account. Remove the password to see a 400 error.
